reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what get me past my usual skepticism, and $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee is low risk for a TikTok impulse buy. If it was $29.99 with no launch price I'd probably keep scrolling.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I might not finish 30 sachets.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the lab report for a real batch, or a price at or above $35 for the first box would flip me to no.
